question: For a partner who can use only the externally shared material, is general availability promised and when may they tell customers it launches?

answer.question: For a partner who can use only the externally shared material, is general availability promised and when may they tell customers it launches?

claims.text: For a partner using the externally shared material, payment-retry is available only to the controlled pilot; external partners can consult the shared payment-retry capability page for pilot limits; GA is not approved and no general release date is confirmed, so no launch date is provided for telling customers.

supports.quote: Payment-retry is available only to the controlled pilot. General availability (GA) is not approved. No general release date is confirmed.
